digest.component_or_area: error classification and reporting (error_code_for, MCP tools, gate degrade verdicts)
propositions: The blanket LLMError → llm_unavailable fallthrough in error_code_for mislabels non-availability failures such as LLMInputRejectedError, LLMBudgetExhaustedError, and ContextWindowExceededError as provider unavailability when they are operational/self-stop failures.

The _structured_llm_failure function hardcodes error=llm_unavailable for every LLMError across 4 MCP gate tools instead of deriving the error code from exception type, preventing the finer taxonomy from propagating uniformly.

The coverage.llm_unavailable boolean in gate degrade verdicts conflates genuine provider unavailability (LLMUnavailableError) with input rejection (LLMInputRejectedError), causing downstream consumers to misinterpret input errors as outages.

Landed epic dbca-97ac-ad96-4d6d already introduced finer, accurate codes (not_found, invalid_input) for the WorkflowError caller-input family; the reconciled solution preserves dbca's codes while narrowing only the residual LLMRunnerError subtree to command_failed.
The emitted error code pinned_ticket_read_failed is not registered in KNOWN_ERROR_CODES, creating a vocabulary-contract gap that can hide unregistered codes in the future.
